We have 

$$
\begin{aligned} & \overset{\to }{OA}=a=i+3j, \\  & \overset{\to }{OB}=b=2i-2j.\end{aligned}
$$

Expressing $\overrightarrow{AB}$ as the difference of position vectors, we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB} & =\overset{\to }{OB}-\overset{\to }{OA} \\  & =b-a \\  & =(2i-2j)-(i+3j) \\  & =i-5j\end{aligned}
$$

Now, using the formula for the magnitude of a vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|\overset{\to }{AB}| & =\sqrt{{1}^{2}+(-5)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{1+25} \\  & =\sqrt{26}.\end{aligned}
$$
